model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating, with the baseline and post-gating values being similar. The figure consists of two line plots, each showing the sparsity ratio of SDPA output as a function of the layer number. The left plot, titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2," has a y-axis labeled "Sparsity Ratio" ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 in increments of 5. The right plot, titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3," has the same y-axis and x-axis labels and scales. It also contains three lines: a red dashed line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio before gate," a red dotted line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after gate," and a red solid line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after average gate." These lines follow a similar pattern to the left plot, starting at approximately 0.8 and decreasing with increasing layer number, with the solid line showing the lowest sparsity ratio.
model_annotations.English:
Figure 4: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

This figure presents two line plots that compare the sparsity ratio of SDPA output before and after gating for two different thresholds, 1e-2 and 1e-3. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number in the model and ranges from 0 to 20 in increments of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The left plot, for threshold 1e-2, shows three lines: "sparsity ratio before gate" (green, solid line), "sparsity ratio after gate" (blue, dashed line), and "sparsity ratio after average gate" (orange, dotted line). All three lines start at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and show a general decreasing trend as the layer number increases. The right plot, for threshold 1e-3, displays the same three lines with similar trends, starting at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and decreasing. The data labels indicate that for threshold 1e-2, the average sparsity ratio before gating is 0.66, and after average gating it is 0.33. For threshold 1e-3, the average sparsity ratio before gating is 0.63, and after average gating it is 0.088. The plots illustrate that the mean absolute values are similar before and after gating, with the sparsity ratio decreasing with increasing layer depth.
model_annotations.German: Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating, with the baseline and post-gating values being similar. The figure consists of two line graphs, each plotting the sparsity ratio of SDPA output against the layer number. The left graph, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2," shows the sparsity ratio on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on the y-axis, with the x-axis representing the layer number from 0 to 20 in increments of 5. The right graph, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3," uses the same y-axis scale and x-axis range. In both graphs, four lines are plotted: a green dashed line for the sparsity ratio before gating (avg 0.66 on the left, avg 0.63 on the right), a blue dashed line for the sparsity ratio after gating (avg 0.44 on the left, avg 0.26 on the right), a red dotted line for the sparsity ratio after average gating (avg 0.33 on the left, avg 0.088 on the right), and a black dotted line for the sparsity ratio after average gating with pre-gating hidden states (avg 0.33 on the left, avg 0.088 on the right). In the left graph, the green dashed line starts at approximately 0.66 and gradually decreases to about 0.44 at layer 20. The blue dashed line starts at around 0.44 and decreases to approximately 0.28 at layer 20. The red dotted line begins at 0.33 and declines to around 0.18 at layer 20. The black dotted line follows a similar trend, starting at 0.33 and decreasing to about 0.18 at layer 20. In the right graph, the green dashed line starts at approximately 0.63 and decreases to about 0.26 at layer 20. The blue dashed line starts at around 0.26 and decreases to approximately 0.12 at layer 20. The red dotted line begins at 0.088 and remains relatively flat, ending at about 0.088 at layer 20. The black dotted line follows a similar pattern, starting at 0.088 and ending at approximately 0.088 at layer 20.
